heading: Monday, September 15, 2025
topLine: OpenAI releases GPT-5-Codex for agentic coding.

items.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-5-Codex for agentic coding
items.summary: GPT-5-Codex is a version of GPT-5 optimized for agentic software engineering in Codex, adjusting its thinking time to task complexity and trained for code review. It became the default for Codex cloud tasks; API access followed on September 23.
